caseName: Strickland v. Seaboard Air Line Railroad
caseNameFull: Strickland v. Seaboard Air Line Railroad Co.
attorneys: William C. Gaither for petitioner. Charles R. Scott and James B. McDonough, Jr. for respondent.

opinions.text:
On petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Florida.

Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted and the judgment is reversed. Bailey v. Central Vermont R. Co., 319 U. S. 350.
